summary.zh: 上线前定好模型选型、缓存和 token 上限，控制费用
summary.en: Set model choice, caching and token limits before the bill arrives

description.zh: 在功能上线前把模型选型、提示缓存、max_tokens 上限和按功能记账定下来，而不是等账单出来再补。适合新建 LLM 功能、成本明显上涨，或需要给某个功能定预算时使用。
description.en: Locks in model routing, prompt caching, max_tokens limits and per-feature cost logging before launch rather than after the bill arrives. Use it when adding an LLM feature, cutting spend or budgeting a specific feature.
